safety_findings: No material PR-015 safety gap observed. The portfolio HTML contains no Margaret Morse quotation, named-lens testimonial, professor praise, or protected educational-record projection; about.html cites the contemporaneous public article but states that it does not establish consent to republish participant details or images.

sunday-dinner.html omits participant names, contacts, invitation and attendance histories, messages, proposals, addresses, access instructions, and unapproved images; it credits the 196 / Sunday Dinner community and separately identifies a publicly documented co-organizer where relevant.

fair-rent.html repeatedly preserves collective causality and shared-account authorship, credits coalition collaborators, and excludes private notes, legal-review material, stakeholder lists, raw strategy context, private email, unapproved quotations, and archive metadata.

wowlist.html credits Richard Caceres and the wider organizer, editor, facilitator, maintainer, and participant community while keeping private user data, contact lists, member records, and authenticated material offline.
The contact phone appears only in the supplied resume PDF; a confined scan of the rendered HTML found no phone number or tel link.
